description: Source code for Samsung's OMX MPEG4/H.263 encoder component, including initialization, parameter handling, encoding, and deinitialization functions.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_GetParameter
methods.description: Handles getting various parameters for MPEG4/H.263 encoder, including profile, level, and error correction settings.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_SetParameter
methods.description: Handles setting various parameters for MPEG4/H.263 encoder, including profile, level, and role.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_SetConfig
methods.description: Handles setting configuration parameters for the encoder.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_ComponentRoleEnum
methods.description: Enumerates the component role, distinguishing MPEG4 or H.263 encoder roles.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MPEG4/H.263 encoder component, opens driver, allocates buffers, and sets default parameters.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_Terminate
methods.description: Terminates the encoder component, closes driver.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4_Encode
methods.description: Performs encoding of input data, manages buffer setup, and retrieves encoded output.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_Mpeg4Enc_bufferProcess
methods.description: Processes input/output buffers, manages encoding state, and calls encode function.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentInit
methods.description: Component initialization function, sets up component, ports, and default parameters for MPEG4 or H.263 encoding.
